about_the_game:
The experimental facility of Hexagon Experiments is designed with four interlocking hexagonal structures. The first hexagon (Main Hexagon) contains two rooms: one for staff and patient entry, and the other for exit. Once you leave the entry room, you cannot re-enter it. Once you enter the exit room, you cannot leave. The second hexagon (Second Hexagon) has 16 rooms where test subjects reside. There are two corridors connecting it to the third hexagon. The second hexagon rotates clockwise after a set period. The third hexagon (Third Hexagon) contains 40 rooms and also has two connecting corridors. It rotates counterclockwise after a set period. Finally, the fourth hexagon (Fourth Hexagon) has 66 rooms with no connecting corridors. It rotates clockwise after a set period.

The game is in third-person perspective. The main character starts in an initial room equipped with a weapon, flashlight, and ammunition. Once the player leaves the room, re-entry is impossible. Beyond general details in the introductory video, no in-game guidance will be provided.

short_description: In Hexagon Experiments, Jhon Watcher becomes a test subject to escape. In a prison research facility, an infection spreads. The cure’s inside, exit’s locked. Find the keycard and escape!

English*, Turkish
